product.title: Amsterdam Classic Saloon Boat Cruise, Drinks and Cheese Option

description.text: Elevate an Amsterdam canal cruise aboard a classic covered wooden saloon boat along UNESCO-listed canals. Onboard commentary points out the Anne Frank House, Westerkerk, the Rijksmuseum, the Amstel, and the Jordaan while the skipper handles canal routing. Depart from two central locations, with an option for Dutch cheese, mustard, and unlimited beer, wine, and soft drinks. The one-hour format is built for visitors who want canal views without choosing a dock or self-guided audio. Stops include Anne Frank House, Westerkerk, Rijksmuseum, The Amstel, The Jordaan.
